name: slugify-accents
title: Accent-aware slugify
prompt:
Make `slugify()` in `text_utils.py` produce clean URL slugs:
- lowercase ASCII only, accents removed (é→e, ç→c, à→a, ï→i)
- every run of characters that are not letters or digits becomes a single `-`
- no leading or trailing `-`

Example: `"  Écoles d'Été — Algérie 2026! "` → `"ecoles-d-ete-algerie-2026"`
